description.p: Inkpad is a distraction-free Markdown editor. The page is the whole window: no toolbar, no title bar, just your text in a comfortable column that reflows as you zoom.

A spotlight dims everything but the paragraph or sentence you are writing, the caret line can be anchored mid-screen so the page scrolls under it, and a frosted-glass mode lets the desktop show through. Light, sepia and dark themes and three bundled writing fonts come with it.
Typing sounds and background music keep you company: gentle key sounds, bundled instrumental loops, generated soundscapes (rain, a night of crickets, a train, a breeze, a drone), or your own tracks.
